name: @flexi/shared-types
description: Shared TypeScript types/enums/DTOs used by both apps/backend and apps/frontend to avoid drift.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }))" && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))"
